note: Each enclosed set or row is one group. Count actual objects, not their decorative parts. For this introductory model, use one group count times one common group size only when group sizes match. Unequal collections can still be totaled by addition, regrouping, or combining multiplication and addition. Captions provide mathematical notation; artwork contains no text.
style: Concept-focused text-free diagrams and simple object illustrations
